intent: Unify SEIS, SEIS-Cloud, SEIS-Code, SEIS-Design, SEIS-Data, SEIS Security, SEIS Research, SEIS Automation, SEIS Product, and public SEIS Command Center source packages into one versioned, repo-contained AI-native agent surface while keeping live external capabilities approval-gated.

consolidationPolicy.futurePluginIntake: Every future cross-lane SEIS plugin must be registered in assets/unified-suite.json; future SEIS Core app packages must also be published under plugins/seis-core as public seis-repo entries.

applicationSourceBoundary.futureIntake: New public plugins for the SEIS Command Center are created under plugins/seis-core/<plugin-name>, use MIT metadata, regenerated into the app inventory/catalog, published as seis-repo entries, and covered by the unified suite without entering packages/seis-ai or becoming personal sources.

websiteRoadmap.releasePolicy: Build the website only when SEIS-AI Agent is ready for a deliberate public release decision.
websiteRoadmap.direction: Cinematic, premium, design-driven, accessible, responsive, and grounded in real SEIS product surfaces.

guardrails: keep development inside the SEIS repo
do not deploy, authenticate, or enable live external access before explicit release decision
keep memory and context systems under SEIS-Data and SEIS-Agent governance
validate plugin, terminal install, docs, and generated reports before handoff
